summary: Reject unsafe MCP receipt request identifiers before cleanup

delivery.outcome: Publish strict receipt request-id validation before MCP cleanup scans or effects, preventing filesystem traversal and unsafe receipt filenames.
nonGoals: No changes to existing receipt contents or publication authority
No runtime dependencies or new MCP operations

architecture.decision: Share one portable request-id validator between receipt readback and cleanup execution, validating before directory access or scans.
interfaceChanges: Reject malformed request identifiers before any cleanup operation; keep normal and automatically generated identifiers valid.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected publication; preserve receipt history.
